reference.name: MFeval 4.3.1 (Marco Furlan, BSD-3), unmodified, run under GNU Octave 8.4
reference.note: MFeval is the MATLAB implementation of Pacejka's Magic Formula 5.2 / 6.1 / 6.2 matched by its author to the TNO MF-Tyre 6.1.2.1 solver where that solver differs from the book. The golden files are its output, one process per operating point.

tolerance.note: plus an absolute floor per column in run.mjs (1e-9; 1e-7 for Re, rho, Rl; 1 N/m for Cz); the reference's own NaN / Inf cells are skipped

tyres.note: Project Chrono Audi 245/40 R18, PAC2002, BSD-3; the file has no FITTYP: treat PROPERTY_FILE_FORMAT 'PAC2002' as FITTYP 21
synthetic: the Chrono Audi coefficients plus 6.x terms chosen by OpenGrid, not a measurement
synthetic, as above, with the MF 6.2 loaded-radius terms
MFeval's own example tyre (BSD-3 with the toolbox)
MFeval's example with the book's default coefficients; Q_FZ2 = 0, so the reference's rho / Rl / Cz are not finite there and are skipped
MFeval's example FSAE tyre; Q_FZ2 = 0, as above
